case: CSV export/import of a computed CASE result over STRICT ANY
contract: A mixed CASE result keeps conservative fallback metadata and produces INTEGER, TEXT, SQL NULL, BLOB and tag-prefix-shaped TEXT values.
The app result-file writer and CSV importer restore these values into INTEGER, ANY and TEXT destination columns.

Native typeof() and returned values confirm the STRICT ANY destination retains each runtime storage class and exact BLOB bytes; a CASE branch can turn a source SQL NULL into TEXT while another branch remains SQL NULL.
This proves the named SQLite CASE-to-CSV-to-native-import path; COALESCE and other computed-expression consumers remain open.

app_sqlite_any_contracts.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app sqlite_any_contract:: -- --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: COALESCE and other computed-expression consumers, spreadsheet-application re-import, and installed editing remain unproven.
